The state restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
Every world starts from its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.nojumpdelay.reset_on_game_exit.t: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts from its default state.

options.nojumpdelay.multiplayer_mode.bla: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.nojumpdelay.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
